strengths: Demonstrated consumer-facing feature ownership at scale: card controls used by 2.1 million customers (Revolut) aligns with Spotify's goal of serving 'a billion customers'.
Track record of cross-functional stakeholder management across engineering, design, and business teams, matching the posting's emphasis on working with engineering, design, and other disciplines.
Data-driven improvement of customer-facing outcomes (18% chargeback reduction, 34% settlement failure reduction) matches the posting's focus on data to improve customer experience and confidence.
gaps: No evidence of identity/access/session-management domain experience, which is the core focus of this specific role.
No evidence of platform or infrastructure-level product work (vs. feature/payments product work).
No evidence of collaboration with security teams or partner/device integration teams, which the posting specifically calls out.

requirements.requirement: Own consumer-facing product at scale (millions of users)
requirements.explanation: Resume shows card controls launch used by 2.1 million customers at Revolut, a consumer-facing feature at scale.

requirements.requirement: Session management / identity & access technical product strategy
requirements.explanation: No evidence of identity, authentication, session management, or access-control product work; resume is payments-focused (Faster Payments, chargebacks, claims flow).

requirements.requirement: Cross-functional work with engineering, design, research, security, partnerships
requirements.explanation: Resume shows stakeholder management across engineering, design, business teams, but no mention of research, security, or partner integration teams specifically.

requirements.requirement: Technical product strategy for platform/infrastructure capabilities
requirements.explanation: Experience is in payments feature delivery (settlement failures, claims flow) rather than platform/infrastructure or identity systems that 'enable the business to scale'.

requirements.requirement: Data-driven approach to improving customer outcomes
requirements.explanation: Resume cites reducing chargeback disputes 18% and settlement failures 34% via data-informed redesigns, matching the posting's emphasis on data-driven decisions for customer experience.

requirements.requirement: Team leadership / hiring
requirements.explanation: Posting doesn't specify people-management requirements, though resume shows leading 6 engineers and 2 designers plus hiring.

strengths: Demonstrated senior PM ownership of a technical, infrastructure-adjacent product (Faster Payments integration) with measurable outcomes, matching the posting's call for end-to-end product ownership.

Track record of using customer/data feedback to iterate on features (18% reduction in chargeback disputes via claims flow redesign), aligning with the posting's 'Voice of the Customer' and iterative execution emphasis.
Experience leading cross-functional teams (engineers, designers) matches the posting's cross-functional leadership requirement.
gaps: No evidence of application security, API/web protection, or threat/abuse pattern domain experience required for this role.
No evidence of experience with security governance, schema enforcement, or LLM protection topics central to this posting.
No evidence of enabling sales organizations or producing security-specific technical documentation as required.

requirements.requirement: Application security / API/web protection domain expertise
requirements.explanation: Resume shows payments and consumer fintech product experience (Faster Payments, card controls); no evidence of security, threat protection, or governance domain work.

requirements.requirement: Experience with LLM/API protection, schema-aware enforcement, third/fourth-party risk
requirements.explanation: No mention of API security, LLM protection, or related technical security concepts in resume.

requirements.requirement: Own product roadmap for security controls at global infrastructure scale
requirements.explanation: Resume experience is at consumer banking scale (2.1M customers) but not infrastructure/network security scale like Cloudflare's.

requirements.requirement: Partner with engineering, security specialists, and GTM on technical documentation
requirements.explanation: Resume shows cross-functional stakeholder management with engineering and design, transferable PM skill, but no security specialist collaboration or technical security documentation evidenced.

requirements.requirement: Voice of customer feedback loops and iterative execution
requirements.explanation: Resume shows data-driven iteration: reduced chargeback disputes 18% via redesigning claims flow, cut settlement failures 34%.

requirements.requirement: Senior PM level ownership of end-to-end product journey
requirements.explanation: Resume shows Senior Product Manager title at Starling Bank owning Faster Payments integration end-to-end, leading a team of 6 engineers and 2 designers.

strengths: Direct payments domain experience: Starling Bank 'Owned the Faster Payments integration, cutting settlement failures by 34%' matches the posting's focus on payments infrastructure.
Data-driven approach: resume's 'track record of using data to improve customer-facing outcomes' aligns with the posting's 'Analytical horsepower' requirement.
Consumer-facing feature ownership at scale (card controls used by 2.1 million customers) aligns with the posting's emphasis on building capabilities that bring value to customers.
gaps: Posting requires 10+ years of PM experience; resume shows roughly 6-7 years (2018-present).
No evidence of fraud/risk, AI/ML intelligence platform, or data science collaboration experience required for this specific team (Radar, Authorization Boost, Disputes).
No evidence of external customer or third-party partner-facing experience as specifically called out in the posting.
No evidence of Staff-level scope: setting long-term vision/strategy across a broader platform or organization.

requirements.requirement: 10+ years of relevant Product Management experience
requirements.explanation: Resume shows PM roles from 2018-Present (Revolut 2018-2021, Starling 2021-Present) — approximately 6-7 years total, not 10+.

requirements.requirement: Payments domain expertise
requirements.explanation: Resume shows direct payments PM experience: Faster Payments integration at Starling, card controls and chargeback reduction at Revolut.

requirements.requirement: Strong business acumen / building product solutions to improve business
requirements.explanation: Evidenced by settlement failure reduction (34%) and chargeback dispute reduction (18%), though not at the scale/strategic level implied by 'Staff' scope.

requirements.requirement: Customer and partner-facing experience
requirements.explanation: Resume mentions stakeholder management across engineering, design, business teams but no explicit external customer/partner-facing experience described.

requirements.requirement: Operational savvy: designing and driving cross-functional team and process
requirements.explanation: Led a team of 6 engineers and 2 designers, and led hiring — shows some cross-functional operational leadership, but scope is smaller than Staff-level expectations.

requirements.requirement: Analytical horsepower / data-driven decision making
requirements.explanation: Resume states 'track record of using data to improve customer-facing outcomes' and lists Product Analytics and SQL skills.

requirements.requirement: Vision/strategy for intelligence platform involving AI/ML, fraud, data science collaboration
requirements.explanation: No evidence in resume of fraud, risk, AI/ML, or data science collaboration experience — only general payments features and card controls.

requirements.requirement: Staff-level scope (long-term vision, strategy, setting pace for team)
requirements.explanation: Resume shows Senior PM/PM level responsibilities managing small teams (6 engineers, 2 designers), not staff-level org-wide strategy setting.

strengths: Resume shows 6+ years of product management experience, exceeding the posting's 4+ year minimum.

Track record of end-to-end feature ownership at scale (card controls used by 2.1 million customers), matching the posting's call for owning 'end-to-end product strategy and roadmap ... from discovery through scaled launch.'

Demonstrated cross-functional stakeholder management (engineering, design, business teams), aligning with the posting's requirement to 'align cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders around shared goals without direct authority.'
Data-driven track record (34% reduction in settlement failures, 18% reduction in chargeback disputes) supports the posting's emphasis on being 'highly data-literate.'
gaps: No evidence of experience in operationally complex physical environments (e.g., logistics, retail, grocery, marketplace fulfillment) as requested by the posting.
No evidence of running formal A/B or multivariate experimentation programs.
No experience with two-sided marketplace dynamics (shopper and customer) as central to this role.
No mention of AI/LLM technology exposure, which the posting frames as central to the role's opportunity.

Data-driven decision-making shown via SQL/Product Analytics skills and quantified outcomes (34%, 18% improvements), aligning with the posting's call for data literacy and analytical rigor.
